figure.title: Aerodynamic characteristics in pitch of the various wing-body configurations. (d) Λ = 47°; t/c = 0.06. (Caption as printed on the page: '(d) Λ = 47°; t = 0.06.' and 'Figure 6.- Continued.')
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, C_L, common to the three plots of the page and labelled only under the bottom (angle-of-attack) plot: -.2 at the left frame line, 0 at the heavy axis line, .8 at the right frame line, labels every 0.1. On the graph paper the heavy vertical lines fall every 0.05 C_L (about 71.5 px on this page), a medium line halfway between them (every 0.025), fine lines every 0.005 (about 7.1 px). The C_L = 0 line is drawn heavier than the other heavy lines.
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, C_D, scale on the right of the middle plot: labels 0, .04, .08, .12, .16, .20. The heavy horizontal lines fall every 0.02 C_D (about 71.5 px; the labels sit on every second one), a medium line halfway between them (every 0.01), fine lines every 0.002 (about 7.1 px). The C_D = 0 line is drawn heavier than the other heavy lines.
figure.content_note: Middle plot of the page only (C_D against C_L). One faired curve with 8 hollow circles (radius about 13 px), all single: no doubled outline or second circle seen. Circles 1, 2 and 3 show a faint speck near the centre (a pin prick or dirt, not a drawn centre dot like the other NACA reports; the ring fit ignores it). Circle 2 has its left edge on the heavy C_L = 0 axis line and the heavy 0.02 C_D line across its lower part, with the faired curve through it; circle 4 has its top edge close to the 0.04 C_D line and a vertical line through it; circle 5 has a vertical grid line through it. The pitching-moment plot of this page shows two symbols at about the C_L of circle 5 (about 0.31); the drag plot shows only one circle there, with no second outline seen at high zoom (a second point with the same C_L and C_D would be hidden under it). The scan has a horizontal seam at y about 983-985 where the vertical lines step by about 2 px, and 1-px steps of the horizontal lines along vertical seams (e.g. near x 557, 700 and 1850); horizontal lines are about 13 px higher at the right frame than at the left.

calibration.x_definition: C_L: vertical heavy and medium grid lines of the graph paper, every 0.025 from the left frame line (-0.20) to the right frame line (0.80).
calibration.y_definition: C_D: horizontal heavy and medium grid lines, every 0.01 from the heavy C_D = 0 line (labelled 0) to the 0.20 line (labelled .20).
